import struct, sys, zlib
sys.path.insert(0, "/app")
from main import solve

def rec(seq, kind, txid, payload=b"", plen=None, crc_ok=True):
    if plen is None: plen = len(payload)
    hdr = struct.pack("<IIBI", plen, seq, kind, txid)
    crc = zlib.crc32(hdr + payload) & 0xffffffff
    if not crc_ok: crc ^= 0xFF
    return hdr + payload + struct.pack("<I", crc)

def patch(pi, bo, data):
    return struct.pack("<HHH", pi, bo, len(data)) + data

def commit(staged, cnt=None, dg=None):
    if cnt is None: cnt = len(staged)
    if dg is None: dg = zlib.crc32(b"".join(staged)) & 0xffffffff
    return struct.pack("<II", cnt, dg)
